sources.invariant: Export exact commits with git archive. Assert every runtime file equals the original I binding; the newer candidate commit contains only compatibility fixture repairs and preserved failure evidence. Download exact LoCoMo bytes; reconstruct each database once using the released baseline runtime, same frozen loaders and original session order. Record new DB byte hashes, logical table digests, sizes, data fingerprints, source files, dependencies, tokenizer cache hashes and VM identity. Close and verify no sidecars; both labels copy the same newly bound immutable DB. Commit this binding remotely before first timing. New hashes are never represented as original F bytes. Controller memory during snapshot hashing is outside the native worker boundary and supplies no formal resource or cross-host memory comparison.

schedule.selection: Unchanged 128 old IDs per cohort in the original I binding; independently verify selection from frozen data.
schedule.order: Same random.Random(91261 + round*1009 + configuration_index) schedule. Single worker at a time on this isolated VM; no concurrent CPU work.
schedule.scope: A separately identified prospective recovery decision permits this new complete diagnostic. Never combine old and new VM timings or reuse completed old worker records in this new estimate.

durability.initial_claim: Reject an existing fixed result branch and any preexisting output/state. Only github.run_attempt==1 on the exact ci branch can execute.
durability.stages: Verified non-force remote push of an explicit intent before each worker; preserve the complete or partial result, exit receipt and log remotely before the next worker.
durability.publication: Verify expected previous result head and exact new commit after each push. On divergence or ambiguous push preserve failure evidence and stop without automatic write/measurement retry.
durability.failure: Retain every failed/incomplete/slower observation and available cell-granularity partial result. Workflow always step preserves logs, partial files, source-free receipts; artifacts upload runs even if Git publication fails. No database or source plaintext is published.
durability.no_retry: Do not rerun the old I profile, old claimed worker, or this fixed hosted attempt automatically. Any future recovery must be prospectively named with all failed evidence retained.

audit: Compute only from saved rows: exact eight-worker inventory, 4096 calls, 2048 full non-timing payload pairs, all query/configuration orders, finite observations, per-round and pooled p50/p95/mean, p95 geometric change, all adverse cells. No retrieval in audits.
formal_and_release: All original round5-plan.json 14-cell/66248-call numerical gates, full-payload equality, resource review, historical lexical/Q2 compatibility, future fresh quality validation and release verification remain unchanged. This old-data development diagnostic does not certify formal performance acceptance or competitor superiority.
